note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026), Kosovo, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahwealj992) and average post-tax disposable income (adiincj992) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. The database files Kosovo under the code KS (its metadata's country name for KS is Kosovo; its file XK holds no figures). Its metadata gives the figures in EUR, and its market exchange rate in local currency per euro (xlceuxi999) is 1.0005 for 2024, the euro's, so they are read as EUR. Read 2026-10-31.
